headline: Capital Market Chief Warns Capital Misallocation Costs India Up to ₹8 Lakh Crore
summary: Financial executive Nilesh Shah highlighted that weak law enforcement and speculative misallocation of household savings cost the Indian economy ₹7 lakh crore to ₹8 lakh crore annually.
why: India's domestic financial regulators are encouraging a shift in retail savings away from speculative derivative trading into capital-forming investments.
